Fixes BOR-

## Summary
What changes, in a few sentences. Before and after, if it changes behavior.

## Why
The problem this solves, or the issue it closes.

## Validation
How it was tested: commands run, tests added, what you checked by hand.

## Risk and confidence
Risk: low | medium | high. One-line reason.
Confidence: low | medium | high. One-line reason.

## Follow-ups
Work left for later, or "None".

## Notes for the reviewer
Anything else a reviewer needs: where to start, tradeoffs, open questions.
